title: Join the pool
intro: Share this computer with the pool. While this tab is open, it runs an AI model on the graphics chip and does AI work for everyone in the pool.
choice-none-sub: Only the upscaler, for computers with little graphics memory.
choice-strong-sub: Qwen3 4B. Better answers, also in Estonian. Needs Apple Silicon with 16 GB or more, or a GeForce card with 6 GB or more.
choice-largest-sub: Qwen3.5 9B. The best answers, also in Estonian, but slower. Needs Apple Silicon with 16 GB or more, or a GeForce card with 8 GB or more.
choice-upscale-sub: Also makes pictures four times larger.
nothing-chosen: Choose a model or the upscaler first.
does-run: Downloads the model you chose, once, and runs it on this computer’s graphics chip.
does-answer: Writes the answers for anyone in the pool who asks for that model.
does-upscale: With the upscaler ticked, makes pictures four times larger.
does-usage: Records each piece of work on the usage page: the model, tokens, time and your id.
does-one: Does one piece of work at a time. If you leave in the middle, a paid service finishes it.
never-files: Open your files, run programs or install anything.
never-keep: Keep or show what was asked.
never-learn: Teach the model anything. It is a fixed file.
never-background: Run after the tab is closed.
never-incoming: Accept incoming connections. It only connects out, to the addresses below.
addr-pool-why: this page, sign-in, the upscaler file, and one outgoing connection for the work
addresses-note: The browser blocks every other address for this page (its Content Security Policy).
stores-title: What it stores, and how to stop
stores-what: The model files, in this browser’s storage for pool.visualia.space, and a sign-in cookie. Nothing else.
stores-stop: To stop: press Leave, or close the tab.
stores-block: Whoever runs the pool can revoke your key, and IT can block pool.visualia.space.
code: The code is in the Visualia repository, apps/pool.
no-webgpu: This browser can’t join: it needs WebGPU. Use Chrome or Edge.
hint-strong: Graphics: {chip}. This looks strong enough for the bigger models, if the computer has the memory above.
hint-weak: Graphics: {chip}. The small model is the safe choice here.
welcome: In the pool with {model}. Waiting for work. {n} computers in the pool, this one included.
welcome-alone: In the pool with {model}. Waiting for work. This is the only computer in the pool right now.
connection-lost: Connection lost. Trying again in {seconds} s.
waiting: In the pool. Waiting for work.
removed: The models are removed from this browser.
